This protected workflow is a PR-admission gate and cannot be given a push trigger by an ordinary change. The publication gate resolves the unique merged pull request associated with the product commit, requires that pull request to target main, and binds its head SHA to the product commit's second parent. It enumerates repository-wide pull_request_target runs at that PR head and requires every run at this workflow path to succeed under either the canonical file workflow id or a reviewed required_workflow_ids pin with this repository's exact required_workflows URL for that id. The pin 382932593 was reviewed against successful required runs for PRs #6944 and #6945 and the required run for #6947. Each required identity also needs an active main-branch workflows rule for this path, this repository's numeric id, and refs/heads/main; conflicting same-path repository or ref entries in the effective main rules block release. Rotating the ruleset to a new identity blocks publication until a reviewed protected change updates the pin. The deprecated required_workflows API cannot query a pinned identity's historical source; acceptance trusts that administrators have not re-pointed its rule between execution and publication, and such administrator changes are out of scope. A direct push has no associated pull request and therefore does not publish.
